schema-missing.fix: Add JSON-LD for LocalBusiness (see schema/ templates)
schema-missing.how: Pages & Menu → page ⋯ → SEO → Advanced SEO → Structured data markup → Add new markup. Paste JSON-LD (max 7,000 chars, up to 5 per page) and check it in the Rich Results Test.

title-quality.fix: Use a readable keyword title, not a design label
title-quality.how: Editor → Pages & Menu → page ⋯ → SEO basics → Title tag. For many pages at once: Dashboard → Marketing & SEO → SEO → SEO Settings → page type → edit the title pattern.

meta-description.fix: Write a 140–160 char description with a call to action
meta-description.how: Pages & Menu → page ⋯ → SEO basics → Meta description. The SEO Settings page-type pattern is the fallback.

h1.fix: Add exactly one descriptive H1 containing the primary topic
h1.how: Select the main heading → Edit text → Semantic tag = Heading 1 (H1). Use only one per page. For spaced lettering, use letter spacing, not spaces typed between letters.

placeholder-text.fix: Replace builder placeholder copy with real content (it looks unfinished to people and engines)
placeholder-text.how: Open the page (or the CMS collection item in Content Manager) and replace the default Wix text. Check dynamic item pages too.

lcp.fix: Compress/preload hero image, cut render-blocking JS
lcp.how: Remove unused apps (Apps → Manage apps). Use a compressed hero image (Wix image settings → quality). Don't put video or slideshows above the fold.

title-length.fix: Aim for 30–60 chars: primary keyword + location/brand
title-length.how: Editor → Pages & Menu → page ⋯ → SEO basics → Title tag. For many pages at once: Dashboard → Marketing & SEO → SEO → SEO Settings → page type → edit the title pattern.

thin-content.fix: Expand with useful, specific text (services, FAQs, proof)
thin-content.how: Add text sections in the Editor (a Text + Image strip). Wix gives no word count, so re-run the audit afterwards.

content-in-pdf.fix: Publish that content as HTML (crawlable, quotable by AI); keep PDF as a download
content-in-pdf.how: Rebuild the PDF content as a Wix page (or use Wix Bookings service/price lists). Keep the PDF as a download link.

expected-page.fix: Add a dedicated services page and link it from the navigation
expected-page.how: Pages & Menu → + Add page. Also add it to the menu so it's linked.

keyword-targeting.fix: Map each primary keyword to one page and use it in title + H1
keyword-targeting.how: Put the keyword in the title tag (SEO basics) and in the page's main heading. In the Editor, select the heading text → Text settings → Semantic tag = H1.

schema-openingHoursSpecification.fix: Include openingHoursSpecification in the main entity markup
schema-openingHoursSpecification.how: Pages & Menu → page ⋯ → SEO → Advanced SEO → Structured data markup → Add new markup. Paste JSON-LD (max 7,000 chars, up to 5 per page) and check it in the Rich Results Test.

schema-sameAs.fix: Include sameAs in the main entity markup
schema-sameAs.how: Pages & Menu → page ⋯ → SEO → Advanced SEO → Structured data markup → Add new markup. Paste JSON-LD (max 7,000 chars, up to 5 per page) and check it in the Rich Results Test.

brand-name.fix: Use one exact business name everywhere (site, GBP, directories, schema)
brand-name.how: Settings → Business info → Business name. Then use the same name in titles, the footer and every profile.

llms.txt-summary.fix: Rewrite the llms.txt summary to describe the business, not a random page
llms.txt-summary.how: Dashboard → SEO → llms.txt → edit the summary paragraph. Once edited it no longer auto-updates.

tbt-inp-proxy.fix: Remove unused apps/widgets and third-party scripts
tbt-inp-proxy.how: Remove unused apps and third-party embeds; limit animations (Editor → Animations).

alt-text.how: Click the image → Settings → 'What's in the image? Tell Google' (the alt text).

og-image.how: Pages & Menu → page ⋯ → Social share → upload a 1200×630 image. The site-wide default is in SEO Settings.

email-domain.fix: Use an address on the site domain, or redirect the old domain to the site

profile-link.fix: Link profiles and add them to schema sameAs

legacy-site: https://yuzuhairandbeauty.u.fix: Take it offline (delete the site or the listing on that platform). old ueni site: says West Ealing, 22 Mattock Lane W5 5BH, 07572 107373

legacy-site: https://yuzuhairandbeauty.c.fix: 301-redirect the whole domain to the main site. email domain shows a One.com 'under construction' page — 301 it to the .london site
legacy-site: https://yuzuhairandbeauty.c.how: At the domain host (e.g. One.com / GoDaddy): add a permanent 301 forward of the whole domain to the main site.
